notes.title: Build 137.
notes.content:
Fixes

    Had to cut the wind feature entirely to prevent serious stability issues.
    Weapon saves are enabled again.
    Opening the options menu while having the inventory open no longer brakes the inventory.
    Removed a weapon perk that was a remnant of the old battle system.

notes.title: Build 136 [beta].
notes.content:
Uploaded to the beta branch.

Fixes
Constrains to wind movement time in the western desert. The old wind effect system was sometimes causing some serious errors and hopefully this brings better stability to the game.
    Improvements to the "End Turn" button functions.
    Fixed some errors related to the deer.


Please note that weapons are currently not saved in beta build 136! Thank you for playing and experimenting with the builds!

notes.title: Build 135.
notes.content:
Fixes

    [When continuing from a Save file] Added a 100 millisecond delay for items spawning in the inventory to avoid any possible visual glitches.
    Camera reset function disabled during walking to prevent moonwalks.
    "The End" screen added.

notes.title: Intro + new camera system
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852302/c108f7357c9ce184497d172eb26d7debcd89808e.gif
New features

    A wonderful intro movie.
    A new, better & much more logical camera movement system! 
    All interactions can be completed with the mouse only! Right click to enter the dungeons. 
    Separated the "Save" function from "Quit & Save".
    Options menu.

Fixes

    Fixed a major world duplication glitch when dying in irradiated water after the first underground battle.
    Re-enabled automatic End Turn.
    Normal difficulty appeared too unforgiving. Units are now many times weaker in a normal setting.

notes.title: Build 132. Oppressor of the wastes.
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852302/d0ee7542e93a81b127856e8f4615a5fc08a4f2e3.gif
New features

    Added the final boss to the game. Travel to a far away hill and enter the underground bunker. Gear up with procedural weapons and collect mutant teeth to beat him.
    Added difficulty settings: easy, normal and hard.
    Ability to save procedural weapons. Thousands of possible combinations!
    Ability to save collected items.
    Save game function is complete.


Fixes

    Fixed the camera rotation bug when leaving Gun-Zu the weapon trader.
    Cleaned the sprites of the main character.

notes.title: Build 130. Faster loading times.
notes.content:
Updated with build 130:

    35% to 60% faster loading times compared to build 129. 
    Hovering over items in the inventory displays their stat effects.
    Clicking items in the inventory displays a short description.
    Added more descriptions to items in different states.
    Disabled the ability to scroll the battle map when inventory is open.
    Fixed a rare visual duplication glitch in the inventory.

notes.title: Update to build 127.
notes.content:
Greetings wastelanders!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28852302/8ace8962566f4eaa290a0f9110cc154a9bb4b4e7.png
Updated with build 127:

    Friendly cats and dogs make an appearance on the screen after rescuing them from the mutants.
    The first three tutorial levels can be skipped by finding black smoke on the shores of the rotten sea.
    Added more tutorial hints.
    Fixed manhole layer problems.
    Fixed walking animation sometimes starting when clicking an item in the inventory.
    Fixed clicking on an item producing a sound when not in an underground battle.
    Saves are now maintained between builds.

notes.title: Update to build 125.
notes.content:
Small update 125:

    Black smoke added to the beginning of the game. Nearing that will give general tutorial hints in how to play the game or change weapons (mouse scroll wheel).
    Fixed the second manhole giving you double the loot.
    Looking back with the right click now correctly hides the sprite of the manhole to the back of the player.
    Removed a lonely fence. 
    Dying in battle will not give mutant teeth anymore.
